title: University of Nottingham
description: The University of Nottingham's official brand guidelines define Nottingham Blue (#10263B) as the primary colour, the supporting colours Jubilee Red (#B91C2E), Mandarin Orange (#F98109), Rebel's Gold (#DEB406), Pioneering Pink (#D7336C), Civic Purple (#792D85), Forest Green (#005F36), Bramley Apple (#93D500), Trent Turquoise (#37B4B0) and Malaysia Sky Blue (#009BC1), and the neutral colours Portland Stone (#FAF6EF) and White (#FFFFFF).
